name: glitchless
description: Let your agent understand your players. Game observability for Unity, Godot, Unreal, Three.js, Roblox, Phaser, Babylon.js, PlayCanvas and GameMaker: ranked findings, frame times, errors, where players die, store reviews and each game's own dashboard, from real players' sessions. Skills add Glitchless to a game, design its dashboard and fix what players hit.
